verdict.rationale: Visa provides REST APIs, an npm-distributed agent-toolkit (TypeScript/MCP), and a sandbox environment (apitest.visaacceptance.com) that could in principle be scripted or invoked from CI/automation pipelines, and the MCP server package is confirmed live on npm. However, the core flow requires human passkey/step-up authentication for enrollment and instruction validation, which cuts against fully headless automation, and there is no explicit documentation or example of running the toolkit or APIs unattended in a CI pipeline. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless automation guide, evidence that mandate/passkey steps can be bypassed or mocked for automated test runs, and independent confirmation of non-interactive end-to-end test execution.
